stage1.impression: A clean, well-organised range shot: eight tinted speakers in spectrum order on white paper, each throwing a long shadow with a coloured patch toward the lens. The idea reads at once and the top-left is empty for type. But it still reads as a render: the paper is a featureless white void, the cabinet fronts are lit flat so the acrylic looks like tinted plastic rather than glowing glass, most of each cast is grey with only a small coloured patch, the smoked unit is a black hole, and the staggered ranks read as speakers at different heights rather than at different depths.

blocking_9: The cast colour has to be the subject of the floor: saturated, luminous patches clearly stronger than the grey shadow mass (red patch g_median <= 130, violet patch b_median >= 175)
The cabinets glow from the backlight (bright top and side edges, a gradient down the face) instead of reading flat-lit by the front face light
The smoked speaker shows form and edges (crush_pct < 1 in its body)
The set has depth: a gentle tonal falloff from front floor to the top of the wall and visible paper grain instead of an even 232 everywhere
No cast shadow leaves the frame edge; the left and right ends stay inside with clear margin
The back rank reads as further back (depth cue from scale, focus or light), not as speakers standing higher
No denoiser smear on the thin horn mounting pins and edges at full 2560 resolution

defects.what: Wall is perfectly even (median 231.8, range 2.4 across the top 120 px): a CG white void with no falloff or depth
Paper floor has no visible tooth or fibre (lum_range 4.5); reads as a smooth CG plane
Smoked speaker crushed: median 16.9, crush 5.8 %, its form and edges are lost
Violet cast is nearly grey (RGB 143/132/164); the colour barely survives the ambient
Green cast is weak (RGB 137/150/132), close to the grey shadow
Red speaker's shadow and colour patch run to the left frame edge (x about 5), a tangent that pulls the eye out of frame
Smoked speaker's shadow runs into the right edge
Cabinet fronts evenly lit by the face light; acrylic reads as flat tinted plastic, little backlit glow through edges
Back-rank speakers (orange, green, violet, smoke) appear the same size but higher in frame; the stagger reads as a height difference, not depth
Thin horn mounting pins soft and smeared by the denoiser
Small red specular dot at the yellow horn's throat reads like a firefly

changes.problem: The coloured casts are washed out by ambient fill on the front floor, so the grey shadow mass dominates and violet and green barely read as colour.

change.from: key 17.0 W/m2, over 4.0 W/m2, top 9.0 W/m2
change.to: key 23.0 W/m2, over 2.0 W/m2, top 7.0 W/m2 (re-balance exposure so open paper stays near 228)

changes.expected: A higher sun-to-ambient ratio: coloured patches become saturated, luminous pools while open paper stays at the same level; grey shadows drop a little, so the colour stands out against them.

changes.problem: The face light flattens the cabinet fronts so the acrylic does not glow from the backlight.

evidence.measured: yellow cabinet front, median 84.9, evenly filled with no edge glow; visually all eight fronts are lit identically

change.from: face 6.0 W/m2, edge 3.0 W/m2, sides 10/20 W/m2
change.to: face 3.0 W/m2, edge 6.0 W/m2, sides 14/20 W/m2

changes.expected: Fronts fall slightly darker with bright top edges and side rims from the strips, so the backlit acrylic reads as glass carrying light rather than painted plastic.

changes.problem: The smoked speaker is crushed to a black silhouette and loses its form.

change.to: 22.0 W/m2, and widen it to 0.6 x 2.5 m

changes.expected: Smoked cabinet edges and its inner ribs read; body median rises to about 30 with no crushed pixels.

changes.problem: The set is an even white void with no falloff, which reads as CG and gives the frame no depth.

evidence.measured: median 231.8, range 2.4; cove [0,300,130,400] 236.6; front floor [0,580,1280,640] 229.5: the same tone everywhere

change.to: 11.0 W/m2, centred 1.5 m up so the wall falls off upward

changes.expected: A soft gradient: the wall top settles about 15 levels below the cove, so the speakers sit in a lit pool and dark title type still has ample contrast.

changes.problem: The end speakers' casts run to the frame edges, pulling the eye out of the picture.

evidence.measured: red patch and shadow reach x about 5 (patch region [20,530,190,570] median 164 against 229 paper); smoke shadow reaches x about 1270

changes.expected: Shadows shorten by about 20 %, so the red and smoke casts end at least 40 px inside the frame and the coloured patches sit closer to their speakers.

changes.problem: The paper has no visible grain, so the floor reads as a smooth CG plane.
changes.expected: A fine, visible paper fibre in the foreground that softens under focus falloff toward the wall.

changes.problem: At f/2.8 from 13 m everything is equally sharp, so the back rank reads as standing higher rather than 1.2 m further back.

evidence.measured: seen: back-rank horns sit about 15 px higher and match the front rank in sharpness and size

change.to: (0, -9.5, 1.7), 50 mm, f/2.0, focus on the front rank (y = 0)

changes.expected: Stronger perspective scale between ranks and a slight softening of the back rank, so the stagger reads as depth; the framing stays the same width.

changes.problem: Thin pins and edges are smeared by the denoiser, and there is a firefly-like red dot at the yellow horn's throat.

evidence.measured: seen in the 3x crop: pins soft and blotchy, red dot at about (465, 205)

change.to: 640 samples, denoise at reduced strength with albedo and normal passes, clamp indirect at 10

changes.expected: Crisp pins and edges at 2560 px, no isolated hot specks.

out_of_scope.request: Make the woofer rings read as a richer material (a slight sheen or translucency) instead of flat opaque discs
out_of_scope.why: The rings are part of the speaker; fixed.

out_of_scope.request: Let more of the cabinet pass coloured light so the casts are mostly colour rather than grey
out_of_scope.why: The opaque batts lining the cabinet set the grey shadow mass; they are part of the product.

out_of_scope.request: Lighten the black compression-driver mass inside each horn, which dominates the horn's silhouette
